title: Prime Minister shares glimpses of his address at a programme in Vadodara during the launch of key projects
body_text:
The Prime Minister, Shri Narendra Modi has shared glimpses of his address at a programme in Vadodara during the launch of key projects. In a series of X posts, Shri Modi said; “The 2,800+ km Dedicated Freight Corridor is now complete. This is a major milestone for Gati Shakti and India’s logistics transformation.”
The 2,800+ km Dedicated Freight Corridor is now complete. ✅ This is a major milestone for Gati Shakti and India’s logistics transformation. pic.twitter.com/R8LQpzhg2u — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) September 8, 2026
“India is building: Chips to ships… complete value chains at home. Solar to nuclear… the energy ecosystem for AI, data centres and industries of the future.”
India is building: Chips to ships… complete value chains at home. Solar to nuclear… the energy ecosystem for AI, data centres and industries of the future. pic.twitter.com/0WJjjdYtI8 — Narendra Modi (@narendramodi) September 8, 2026
